rationale: A terminal read failure is not an unresolved mutation. Explicit account recovery remains possible after the read settles, while a read in progress cannot race login/logout.
changes: accountSettled permits either successful account data or a terminal read error; login/logout use this gate, while usage limits still require confirmed authenticated accountReady.
The failed-read message explains the explicit re-read/login/logout options and promises no automatic login. Logout is available even when the failed read could not identify the existing account.

Busy, connected/global admission, operation-store failure, unresolved receipt, original loginId and missing-identity restart guards are unchanged. Cancel of a known original login remains available during account reading.

Regression asserts both actions blocked during held read; no automatic writes or limits after failure; exactly one explicit login or logout; logout rereads signed-out state; unknown login continues to query its original receipt without a fresh attempt.
limits: Local jsdom fixture uses real Api mutation/receipt handling with controlled HTTP responses; no live account login/logout or server changes.
